correctness.rationale: The weighted Hilbert Besov monomials are orthogonal with v_j=2(j+1)^2B(2j+2,gamma+1), γ>1; normalized Bergman moments yield H_m z^k=(A_(m−k)/A_m) overline(z)^(m−k) for k≤m and zero otherwise, hence exactly m+1 positive anti-diagonal singular values (A_j/A_m)sqrt(v_j/v_(m−j)), a>-1. Gamma-ratio limits yield α=(γ−1)/2>0, β=a+1−α, v_j~Cγ j^(−2α), d_j~j^β. Uniform two-sided ratio control and endpoint decomposition justify S_p(m)~m B(1+pβ,1+pα) when pβ>−1, m log m with exact coefficient 1 at pβ=−1, and m^(−pβ)Σ d_j^p when pβ<−1, for every p>0. The supremum transition at β>0 is uniquely bulk-maximized at β/(α+β), at β<0 finitely edge-supported, and β=0 tends sup d_j. Independent finite gamma/beta numerical computations for bulk, critical and edge regimes corroborate the trend, and the convergence proof—not finite sampling—establishes asymptotics. Scope is one-variable Hilbert monomial small Hankel, not big Bergman Hankel.
